name: @polyplug/abi
description: polyplug ABI type definitions for JavaScript/TypeScript
author: polyplug
comment:optionalDependencies: koffi is the Node-only FFI backend (loaded lazily by ffi/index.ts only under Node). It is OPTIONAL so Deno and Bun consumers are never forced to build the koffi native addon — Bun uses its built-in bun:ffi and Deno uses Deno.dlopen. npm installs it automatically for Node consumers; if its native build fails the install still succeeds and only the Node FFI path is unavailable.
